_about: The site's data, described once. Every table the SQL source captions query, where it comes from (raw → staging → mart), who owns it, what each column means, and the tests the nightly run (scripts/data_run.py) holds it to. Pieces map each SQL source caption to the tables it reads. The hidden hunt table is left out on purpose.

site_pages.label: Page markup
site_pages.description: The Home and Projects pages as published. They are the source of truth for the site's own tables, so a table can never say something the pages don't.

stg_site_rows.label: Parsed page rows
stg_site_rows.description: Each card, role, skill, credential and the hero, read out of the page markup into typed rows (dates parsed, badges split from titles).

fraud_supabase.label: Supabase checkout tables
fraud_supabase.description: The fraud pipeline's four raw Postgres tables of simulated webstore checkouts. They stay in Supabase: nothing row-level ever reaches this site.

stg_fraud_base.label: Scored checkouts, last 30 days
stg_fraud_base.description: One row per scored checkout in the last 30 America/New_York days, joined to the generator's answer key. Built inside a read-only transaction on Supabase; only the aggregates below leave it, as data/fraud-snapshot.json.

github_api.label: GitHub public API
github_api.description: Public activity and public repositories for github.com/lmansf. Private work never appears here.

stg_github_events.label: Public GitHub events
stg_github_events.description: One row per public event in the last 30 days, keeping only its id, type, repository and time (no commit messages, names or emails).

projects.label: projects
projects.description: One row per project card on /projects; Home's featured cards are the featured rows.

columns.title: Project name as the card shows it.
columns.badge: Status badge on the card (Live, Running, Retired...), or null.
columns.eyebrow: The small line above the title: kind of project.
columns.featured: True for the three featured projects shown on Home too.
columns.status: active, or archived for retired cards.
columns.links: The card's links as (label, url) pairs.

experience.label: experience
experience.description: One row per role on the Home experience timeline.

columns.note: A short aside after the title (where a role started), or null.
columns.ended: Month the role ended; null while it's current.
columns.is_current: True for the role held now.

tests.name: a role ends after it starts
tests.sql: ended IS NULL OR ended >= started

skills.label: skills
skills.description: The Home toolkit, one row per skill.

columns.skill: The skill as its chip reads.
columns.category: The toolkit group it sits in.

credentials.label: credentials
credentials.description: Certifications and workshops listed on Home.

columns.credential: Name of the certification or workshop.

resume.label: resume
resume.description: One row: who I am, the Home "now" strip, and where to reach me.

columns.name: Full name.
columns.headline: The hero's first clause.
columns.email: Contact email from the Email button.

fraud_totals.label: fraud_totals
fraud_totals.description: One row: the fraud pipeline's last 30 days in total.

columns.flagged: Checkouts sent to review or declined.
columns.fraud: Checkouts the answer key marks as fraud.
columns.legit: Checkouts the answer key marks as legitimate.
columns.fraud_dollars_stopped: Dollars of fraud that were flagged.
columns.fraud_dollars_approved: Dollars of fraud that got through.
columns.p50_scoring_ms: Median time to score a checkout, in milliseconds.
columns.p95_checkout_ms: 95th-percentile time for the whole checkout, in milliseconds.
columns.scoring_timeouts: Checkouts approved because scoring timed out (fail open).
columns.active_days: Days in the window with at least one checkout.

tests.name: caught fraud is no more than all fraud

fraud_daily.label: fraud_daily
fraud_daily.description: One row per America/New_York day with checkouts in the last 30 days.

columns.fraud: Checkouts the answer key marks as fraud.
columns.fraud_dollars_stopped: Dollars of fraud that were flagged.
columns.fraud_dollars_approved: Dollars of fraud that got through.
columns.p95_scoring_ms: 95th-percentile scoring time that day, in milliseconds.

tests.name: approved, reviewed and declined add up to checkouts
the days add up to the 30-day totals
tests.sql: (SELECT sum(d.checkouts) = any_value(t.checkouts) AND sum(d.fraud) = any_value(t.fraud) AND sum(d.fraud_caught) = any_value(t.fraud_caught) FROM fraud_daily d, fraud_totals t)

fraud_score_bins.label: fraud_score_bins
fraud_score_bins.description: The model's score histogram: checkouts per 0.05-wide score bin, split by the answer key.

columns.legit: Legitimate checkouts scored in the bin.
columns.fraud: Fraudulent checkouts scored in the bin.

tests.name: bins sit between 0 and 1
tests.sql: score_from >= 0 AND score_to <= 1 AND score_from < score_to

tests.name: the bins add up to the 30-day totals
tests.sql: (SELECT sum(b.fraud) = any_value(t.fraud) AND sum(b.legit) = any_value(t.legit) FROM fraud_score_bins b, fraud_totals t)

fraud_patterns.label: fraud_patterns
fraud_patterns.description: Fraud and the share caught, by the generator's fraud pattern.

columns.pattern: The kind of fraud the generator played out.
columns.caught: Of those, how many were flagged.

tests.name: the patterns add up to all fraud
tests.sql: (SELECT sum(p.fraud) = any_value(t.fraud) AND sum(p.caught) = any_value(t.fraud_caught) FROM fraud_patterns p, fraud_totals t)

github_activity.label: github_activity
github_activity.description: Public GitHub activity per day and repository, last 30 days.

columns.events: Public events that day (pushes, pull requests, reviews...).

tests.name: pushes are no more than events

github_repos.label: github_repos
github_repos.description: Public repositories on github.com/lmansf (forks left out).

columns.language: GitHub's main language for it, or null.
columns.pushed_on: Day of the last push, UTC.
columns.archived: True if the repository is archived.

live-patterns.label: the catch rate by fraud pattern table
